Brewer.description: Someone who works the brewhouse, cellar or taproom. A first name alone is not an identity.

Beer.description: A beer the brewery makes, named by its recipe, whoever brews it.

Craft.description:
Who works on a beer: its head brewer, the cellar hand who conditions it, or its taster.
Tasting a beer is not brewing it.

Crew.description: How two brewers stand on the rota: one is trained by a mentor, or covered by a relief.

Batch.description: One brew of a beer. brewed_by mashed it, checked_by took the gravity readings, signed_off_by released it.

Order.description: Kegs a customer ordered. taken_by took the order; delivered stays empty until delivery is recorded.

questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Beer)-[:head_brewer]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE n0.recipe = 'Night Ferry Stout' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.speaker: lungile
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Brewer)-[:brewed]->(n1:Beer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.recipe AS recipe

questions.speaker: jaan
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Brewer)-[:mentor]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as
MATCH (n0:Brewer)-[:trainee]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Ayşe Yıldız' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as
MATCH (n0:Batch) WHERE n0.batch_code = 'OB-21' RETURN n0.dry_hopped AS dry_hopped

questions.q: Is there a record that CS-7 was dry hopped?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Batch) WHERE n0.batch_code = 'CS-7' RETURN coalesce(n0.dry_hopped, false) AS dry_hopped

questions.q: What batches did Karim Nassar brew?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Brewer)<-[:brewed_by]-(n1:Batch) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Karim Nassar' RETURN n1.batch_code AS batch_code
MATCH (n0:Batch)-[:signed_off_by]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE n0.batch_code = 'NF-12' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as
MATCH (n0:Batch) WHERE n0.batch_code = 'OB-21' RETURN n0.litres AS litres

questions.q: How many kegs did The Anchor Arms order?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.customer = 'The Anchor Arms' RETURN n0.kegs AS kegs

questions.q: Was the Cafe Lumo order delivered?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) WHERE n0.customer = 'Cafe Lumo' RETURN n0.delivered AS delivered

questions.speaker: ayse
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Brewer)<-[:taken_by]-(n1:Order) WHERE id(n0) = $speaker RETURN n1.customer AS customer
MATCH (n0:Beer)-[:cellar]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE n0.recipe = 'Copper Saint' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as

questions.q: What batches of Low Tide Gose are there?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Beer)<-[:beer]-(n1:Batch) WHERE n0.recipe = 'Low Tide Gose' RETURN n1.batch_code AS batch_code

questions.q: What are the customer and kegs of every order?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Order) RETURN n0.customer AS customer, n0.kegs AS kegs

questions.q: Which batches had a sour note?
questions.cypher: MATCH (n0:Batch) WHERE n0.off_note CONTAINS 'sour' RETURN n0.batch_code AS batch_code
MATCH (n0:Brewer)-[:relief]->(n1:Brewer) WHERE n0.known_as = 'Karim Nassar' RETURN n1.known_as AS known_as
